title: Honest Rating
summary: Shows how many reviews stand behind a star rating and how they split, so a 5.0 from three reviews doesn't look as solid as a 4.6 from 900.
description: Rating summary showing review count and star breakdown, flagging small samples with a likely range for the true score, calling out love-it-or-hate-it splits, and exposing a disclosed Bayesian score for sorting so a 5.0 from 3 reviews can't outrank a 4.6 from 900.
catches: Ratings backed by very few reviews, with a likely range for the true score
Polarised splits hidden by an average
Sorting by raw average: a Bayesian score (IMDb-style) is offered instead
Optional link to read the low reviews first
limits: Statistics assume reviews are genuine; it does not detect fake or incentivised reviews
The prior and weight you pass change the Bayesian score; defaults may not suit your catalogue
The likely range is an approximation (Dirichlet, 90%), not an exact interval
a11y: Breakdown is a labelled list with text labels for each star level
The likely-range bar is role=img with an aria-label stating the range
Warnings are in a polite live region with text, not only icons
Star filters are real buttons, disabled when a level has no reviews
